verdict.rationale: LibreChat has an in-app tool library that users can favorite from (docs-14). It also lets users add MCP servers at runtime from an MCP Settings panel without editing config or restarting (docs-8), and it exposes Skills and agent discovery via a beta management API and a Skills docs page (gh-2, docs-32). None of this shows a real, browsable public registry or marketplace with one-command or one-click install; MCP servers still have to be specified by the user, and the Skills page is only a title. Missing for 10: evidence of a curated or community skills/plugins registry, one-click/one-command install from such a registry, details on how Skills are discovered and installed, and independent hands-on corroboration.
